title: Very Adjustable
text: Very Adjustable. I like an incredibly thin pillow and they're almost impossible to come by these days, everything is incredibly thick and uncomfortable. With this shredded foam pillow you can remove literally as much material as you want. It comes with a bag of additional fill to actually add more fill to the pillow. I took out more fill than they sent to add and I came up with an incredibly thin and soft pillow. . . the only problem is it's all loose fill which makes the pillow wrap around your head and my ears get hot. This is okay in the winter, even nice but in the summer, wow it's hot. Still, this is the thinnest new pillow I've found in years.
